page.overview:
What is Hilel Al-Masaari?

During the Dark Medieval, Hilel al-Masaari was the ancient Assamite warrior who served as the Ashirra Sultan of Cordoba.

Hilel was one of the first Assamites to convert to Islam and he led the Assamite expansion that followed the spread of Islam. Once one of the main candidates for the post of Caliph, Hilel fell victim to political machinations and found himself stuck in Cordoba, a city that didn't suit his warrior spirit at all. Unable to surrender his princedom because of political enemies within Alamut, Hilel ruled his city absently, usually relying on the Vizier Caste of his clan to manage local affairs. He guided his friend, the Gangrel elder Shabaqo, towards conversion in 1005.

Hilel himself preferred following Islamic conquests against the last bastions of Christianity within Iberia and when the Shadow Reconquista began, he was unwilling to leave his city behind and probably met Final Death during the in the last stages of the conflict.

Apparently, he survived to the modern nights, and joined the Assamite Schism.
